# Bootstrap prediction intervals

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(glmnet)


WLAG <- 3L
N_STATES <- 50L
FEATURES_PER <- 21L
LAMBDAS <- 10^seq(3, -2, by = -0.1)

STATE_SEED_BASE <- 10000L
CV_SEED_BASE <- 20000L

state_population <- tibble::tribble(
  ~state, ~population,
  "CA", 39538223, "TX", 29145505, "FL", 21538187, "NY", 20201249,
  "PA", 13002700, "IL", 12812508, "OH", 11799448, "GA", 10711908,
  "NC", 10439388, "MI", 10077331, "NJ", 9288994,  "VA", 8631393,
  "WA", 7705281,  "AZ", 7151502,  "MA", 7029917,  "TN", 6910840,
  "IN", 6785528,  "MD", 6177224,  "MO", 6154913,  "WI", 5893718,
  "CO", 5773714,  "MN", 5706494,  "SC", 5118425,  "AL", 5024279,
  "LA", 4657757,  "KY", 4505836,  "OR", 4237256,  "OK", 3959353,
  "CT", 3605944,  "IA", 3190369,  "UT", 3271616,  "NV", 3104614,
  "AR", 3011524,  "MS", 2961279,  "KS", 2937880,  "NM", 2117522,
  "NE", 1961504,  "ID", 1839106,  "WV", 1793716,  "HI", 1455271,
  "NH", 1377529,  "ME", 1362359,  "RI", 1097379,  "MT", 1084225,
  "DE", 989948,   "SD", 886667,   "ND", 779094,   "AK", 733391,
  "VT", 643077,   "WY", 576851
)

stopifnot(
  exists("final_data"),
  exists("comb6_median_vac.lag3"),
  exists("comb4_median_vac.lag3"),
  exists("predictor_block_exclusions"),
  exists("make_Xdata_train"),
  exists("make_Xdata_test"),
  exists("make_Xlist_new_labeled"),
  exists("make_y_labeled"),
  exists("get_exclusion_mask"),
  nrow(state_population) == 50L
)

final_data <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date, state)

stopifnot(
  nrow(final_data) == 3500,
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_data$state) == 50,
  dplyr::n_distinct(final_data$date) == 70,
  !anyDuplicated(final_data[c("state", "date")]),
  all(rle(as.character(final_data$date))$lengths == 50)
)

all_states <- sort(unique(final_data$state))

MODEL_SPECS <- list(
  with = list(
    k = 6L,
    combo_index = 105L,
    combo = c(1L, 2L, 4L, 5L, 11L, 12L),
    eligible_states = setdiff(all_states, COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES),
    id_prefix = "BOOT_%03d",
    glmnet_args = list(control = list(maxit = 1e6, mxitnr = 100)),
    capture_warnings = FALSE
  ),
  without = list(
    k = 4L,
    combo_index = 103L,
    combo = c(1L, 4L, 8L, 12L),
    eligible_states = setdiff(all_states, c("MN", "MO", "OK")),
    id_prefix = "BOOTSTATE_%03d",
    glmnet_args = list(maxit = 100000),
    capture_warnings = TRUE
  )
)

for (spec in MODEL_SPECS) {
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      as.integer(combn(12, spec$k, simplify = FALSE)[[spec$combo_index]]),
      spec$combo
    )
  )
}

stopifnot(
  length(MODEL_SPECS$with$eligible_states) == 46L,
  length(MODEL_SPECS$without$eligible_states) == 47L
)

glmnet::glmnet.control(mxitnr = 100)
```

```{r}
fold_bounds <- function(i, n_states = N_STATES) {

  if (i == 1L) {
    return(list(
      tr_s = 1L,
      tr_e = n_states * 20L,
      te_s = n_states * 15L + 1L,
      te_e = n_states * 30L
    ))
  }

  tr_s <- (i - 2L) * (n_states * 10L) + (n_states * 5L + 1L)
  te_s <- (i - 1L) * (n_states * 10L) + (n_states * 15L + 1L)

  list(
    tr_s = tr_s,
    tr_e = tr_s + n_states * 25L - 1L,
    te_s = te_s,
    te_e = te_s + n_states * 15L - 1L
  )
}

fold_data <- function(i) {
  fb <- fold_bounds(i)
  list(
    train = final_data[fb$tr_s:fb$tr_e, , drop = FALSE],
    test  = final_data[fb$te_s:fb$te_e, , drop = FALSE]
  )
}


make_original_foldids <- function(k, combo_index) {

  combinations <- combn(12, k, simplify = FALSE)
  stopifnot(combo_index >= 1L, combo_index <= length(combinations))

  selected <- vector("list", 5L)

  set.seed(237)

  for (outer_fold in 1:5) {

    y_train <- make_y_labeled(fold_data(outer_fold)$train)

    for (i in seq_along(combinations)) {

      mask <- get_exclusion_mask(
        combo_idx = combinations[[i]],
        state_vec = y_train$state,
        date_vec = y_train$date,
        exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions
      )

      foldid <- sample(rep(seq_len(10L), length.out = sum(!mask)))

      if (i == combo_index) selected[[outer_fold]] <- foldid
    }
  }

  selected
}

make_bootstrap_train_data <- function(train_data, sampled_states, id_prefix) {

  purrr::imap_dfr(sampled_states, function(source_state, j) {
    train_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(state == source_state) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(date) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = sprintf(id_prefix, j))
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date, state)
}
```

```{r}
fit_one_fold <- function(
    train_data,
    test_data,
    spec,
    train_exclusion_rules,
    foldid = NULL,
    cv_seed = NULL
) {

  X_train_result <- make_Xdata_train(
    dataset = train_data,
    lag = WLAG,
    ylag = WLAG,
    exclusion_rules = train_exclusion_rules
  )

 
  X_test_data <- make_Xdata_test(
    dataset = test_data,
    lag = WLAG,
    ylag = WLAG,
    bs_objects_from_train = X_train_result$bs_objects,
    exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions
  )

  X_train_labeled <- make_Xlist_new_labeled(X_train_result$data)
  X_test_labeled  <- make_Xlist_new_labeled(X_test_data)
  y_train_labeled <- make_y_labeled(train_data)
  y_test_labeled  <- make_y_labeled(test_data)

  key <- function(labeled) {
    paste(as.character(labeled$state), as.character(as.Date(labeled$date)))
  }

  stopifnot(
    identical(key(X_train_labeled), key(y_train_labeled)),
    identical(key(X_test_labeled), key(y_test_labeled))
  )

  X_train_combo <- do.call(
    cbind, lapply(X_train_labeled$X_list[spec$combo], as.matrix)
  )
  X_test_combo <- do.call(
    cbind, lapply(X_test_labeled$X_list[spec$combo], as.matrix)
  )

  storage.mode(X_train_combo) <- "double"
  storage.mode(X_test_combo) <- "double"

  stopifnot(
    ncol(X_train_combo) == spec$k * FEATURES_PER,
    ncol(X_test_combo) == spec$k * FEATURES_PER
  )

  mask_train <- get_exclusion_mask(
    spec$combo, X_train_labeled$state, X_train_labeled$date,
    train_exclusion_rules
  )
  mask_test <- get_exclusion_mask(
    spec$combo, X_test_labeled$state, X_test_labeled$date,
    predictor_block_exclusions
  )

  X_train_f <- X_train_combo[!mask_train, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train_f <- y_train_labeled$obs[!mask_train]
  X_test_f  <- X_test_combo[!mask_test, , drop = FALSE]
  y_test_f  <- y_test_labeled$obs[!mask_test]

  stopifnot(
    all(is.finite(X_train_f)), all(is.finite(y_train_f)),
    all(is.finite(X_test_f)),  all(is.finite(y_test_f))
  )

  if (is.null(foldid)) {
    stopifnot(!is.null(cv_seed))
    set.seed(cv_seed)
    foldid <- sample(rep(seq_len(10L), length.out = nrow(X_train_f)))
  }

  stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_train_f))

  cv_args <- c(
    list(
      x = X_train_f,
      y = y_train_f,
      alpha = 1,
      family = poisson(link = "log"),
      lambda = LAMBDAS,
      standardize = TRUE,
      foldid = foldid
    ),
    spec$glmnet_args
  )

  warning_messages <- character(0)

  if (spec$capture_warnings) {
    cv_fit <- withCallingHandlers(
      do.call(glmnet::cv.glmnet, cv_args),
      warning = function(w) {
        warning_messages <<- c(warning_messages, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    )
  } else {
    cv_fit <- do.call(glmnet::cv.glmnet, cv_args)
  }

  y_pred <- as.numeric(
    predict(cv_fit, type = "response", s = cv_fit$lambda.min, newx = X_test_f)
  )

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(y_pred)), all(y_pred >= 0))

  pred <- tibble::tibble(
    state = as.character(X_test_labeled$state[!mask_test]),
    date = as.Date(X_test_labeled$date[!mask_test]),
    obs = y_test_f,
    pred = y_pred
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

  stopifnot(nrow(pred) == 460L, dplyr::n_distinct(pred$state) == 46L)

  list(pred = pred, warnings = warning_messages, lambda_min = cv_fit$lambda.min)
}
```

```{r}
verify_point_estimate <- function(model_name, reference_object) {

  spec <- MODEL_SPECS[[model_name]]
  foldids <- make_original_foldids(spec$k, spec$combo_index)

  reproduced <- purrr::map_dfr(1:5, function(i) {
    fd <- fold_data(i)
    fit_one_fold(
      train_data = fd$train,
      test_data = fd$test,
      spec = spec,
      train_exclusion_rules = predictor_block_exclusions,
      foldid = foldids[[i]]
    )$pred
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date)

  reference <- reference_object$y_predicted_new[[spec$combo_index]] %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      state = as.character(state),
      date = as.Date(date),
      obs = as.numeric(obs),
      pred = as.numeric(pred)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(reproduced) == 2300L,
    nrow(reference) == 2300L,
    identical(
      paste(reproduced$state, reproduced$date),
      paste(reference$state, reference$date)
    )
  )

  max_obs_diff <- max(abs(reproduced$obs - reference$obs))
  max_pred_diff <- max(abs(reproduced$pred - reference$pred))

  median_rmse <- reproduced %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::summarise(m = median(rmse)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(m)

  cat(sprintf(
    "%-8s | max |obs diff| = %.2e | max |pred diff| = %.2e | median RMSE = %.6f\n",
    model_name, max_obs_diff, max_pred_diff, median_rmse
  ))

  stopifnot(max_obs_diff < 1e-10, max_pred_diff < 1e-6)

  invisible(median_rmse)
}

verify_point_estimate("with", comb6_median_vac.lag3)
verify_point_estimate("without", comb4_median_vac.lag3)
```

```{r}
run_bootstrap <- function(model_name, B) {

  spec <- MODEL_SPECS[[model_name]]
  n_eligible <- length(spec$eligible_states)

  predictions <- vector("list", B)
  warnings_log <- vector("list", B)
  lambda_log <- vector("list", B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    set.seed(STATE_SEED_BASE + b)
    sampled_states <- sample(spec$eligible_states, size = n_eligible, replace = TRUE)

    fold_results <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {

      fd <- fold_data(i)

      boot_train <- make_bootstrap_train_data(
        train_data = fd$train,
        sampled_states = sampled_states,
        id_prefix = spec$id_prefix
      )

      cv_seed <- CV_SEED_BASE + (b - 1L) * 10L + i

      fit <- fit_one_fold(
        train_data = boot_train,
        test_data = fd$test,
        spec = spec,
        train_exclusion_rules = NULL,
        cv_seed = cv_seed
      )

      list(
        pred = fit$pred,
        lambda = tibble::tibble(
          boot = b, fold = i, cv_seed = cv_seed, lambda_min = fit$lambda_min
        ),
        warnings = if (length(fit$warnings) > 0L) {
          tibble::tibble(
            boot = b, fold = i, cv_seed = cv_seed, warning = fit$warnings
          )
        } else {
          NULL
        }
      )
    })

    pred_b <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(fold_results, `[[`, "pred")) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(state, date)

    stopifnot(
      nrow(pred_b) == 2300L,
      dplyr::n_distinct(pred_b$state) == 46L,
      all(dplyr::count(pred_b, state)$n == 50L),
      all(is.finite(pred_b$pred))
    )

    predictions[[b]] <- pred_b %>% dplyr::mutate(boot = b)
    lambda_log[[b]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(fold_results, `[[`, "lambda"))
    warnings_log[[b]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(fold_results, `[[`, "warnings"))

    if (b %% 25L == 0L || b == B) {
      cat(sprintf("%-8s bootstrap %d / %d  (%s)\n",
                  model_name, b, B, format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S")))
    }
  }

  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(predictions)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(out) == B * 2300L,
    dplyr::n_distinct(out$boot) == B,
    all(is.finite(out$pred)),
    all(out$pred >= 0)
  )

  attr(out, "lambda_log") <- dplyr::bind_rows(lambda_log)
  attr(out, "warning_log") <- dplyr::bind_rows(warnings_log)

  out
}

smoke <- run_bootstrap("with", B = 2)
stopifnot(nrow(smoke) == 2 * 2300L)
```

# Negative binomial calibration and scoring

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

DRAWS_PER_BOOT <- 20L      # 500 bootstrap means x 20 = 10,000 draws
CAL_SEED       <- 20260817L
SCORE_SEED     <- 20260818L

WIS_ALPHAS <- c(0.02, 0.05, seq(0.10, 0.90, by = 0.10))

NOMINAL <- c(cov50 = 0.50, cov80 = 0.80, cov95 = 0.95)

CALIBRATION_FOLD <- 1L

PRIMARY_OBJECTIVE     <- "coverage"
SENSITIVITY_OBJECTIVE <- "wis"

THETA_GRID_LO <- 1.0
THETA_GRID_HI <- 60.0

N_COARSE <- 20L
N_FINE   <- 15L


stopifnot(
  length(WIS_ALPHAS) == 11L,
  all(diff(WIS_ALPHAS) > 0),
  exists("boot_full"),
  exists("boot_full_without"),
  exists("state_population")
)
```

```{r}
qfast <- function(x_sorted, p) {

  n <- length(x_sorted)

  stopifnot(
    n > 0L,
    all(is.finite(x_sorted)),
    all(p >= 0 & p <= 1)
  )

  x_sorted[pmax(1L, ceiling(n * p))]
}

local({
  set.seed(1)
  z <- rpois(10000, 7)
  ps <- c(0.01, 0.025, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.975, 0.99)
  stopifnot(identical(
    as.numeric(qfast(sort(z), ps)),
    as.numeric(stats::quantile(z, probs = ps, type = 1, names = FALSE))
  ))
})

# NB2 parameterization: Var(Y | mu) = mu + mu^2 / theta
nb_draws_sorted <- function(mean_rates, population, theta, M = DRAWS_PER_BOOT) {

  stopifnot(
    length(mean_rates) == 500L,
    all(is.finite(mean_rates)),
    all(mean_rates >= 0),
    length(population) == 1L,
    is.finite(population),
    population > 0,
    length(theta) == 1L,
    is.finite(theta),
    theta > 0,
    M >= 1L
  )

  pop_100k <- population / 1e5
  lambda   <- mean_rates * pop_100k

  draws <- stats::rnbinom(
    n = length(lambda) * M,
    mu = rep(lambda, each = M),
    size = theta
  )

  sort(draws / pop_100k)
}

core_scores <- function(draws_sorted, observed_rate, alphas = WIS_ALPHAS) {

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(draws_sorted)), is.finite(observed_rate))

  predictive_median <- qfast(draws_sorted, 0.50)

  lower_all <- qfast(draws_sorted, alphas / 2)
  upper_all <- qfast(draws_sorted, 1 - alphas / 2)

  under_pen <-
    (2 / alphas) * (lower_all - observed_rate) *
    as.numeric(observed_rate < lower_all)

  over_pen <-
    (2 / alphas) * (observed_rate - upper_all) *
    as.numeric(observed_rate > upper_all)

  denominator <- length(alphas) + 0.5

  wis_absolute_error <-
    0.5 * abs(observed_rate - predictive_median) / denominator
  wis_dispersion <-
    sum((alphas / 2) * (upper_all - lower_all)) / denominator
  wis_underprediction <-
    sum((alphas / 2) * under_pen) / denominator
  wis_overprediction <-
    sum((alphas / 2) * over_pen) / denominator

  pi_bounds <- qfast(draws_sorted, c(0.25, 0.75, 0.10, 0.90, 0.025, 0.975))

  c(
    predictive_median = predictive_median,

    wis = wis_absolute_error + wis_dispersion +
          wis_underprediction + wis_overprediction,
    wis_absolute_error = wis_absolute_error,
    wis_dispersion = wis_dispersion,
    wis_underprediction = wis_underprediction,
    wis_overprediction = wis_overprediction,

    lower_50 = pi_bounds[1], upper_50 = pi_bounds[2],
    lower_80 = pi_bounds[3], upper_80 = pi_bounds[4],
    lower_95 = pi_bounds[5], upper_95 = pi_bounds[6]
  )
}
```

```{r}
build_targets <- function(boot_df, label) {

  d <- boot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(state_population, by = "state") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date, boot)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(d) == 1150000L,
    all(is.finite(d$population)),
    all(d$population > 0),
    all(is.finite(d$pred)),
    all(d$pred >= 0),
    all(is.finite(d$obs))
  )

  ti <- d %>%
    dplyr::distinct(state, date, obs, population) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(state, date) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(target_id = dplyr::row_number())

  stopifnot(nrow(ti) == 2300L, dplyr::n_distinct(ti$state) == 46L)

  unique_dates <- sort(unique(ti$date))
  stopifnot(length(unique_dates) == 50L)

  ti <- ti %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fold = ceiling(match(date, unique_dates) / 10))

  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(table(ti$fold)), rep(460L, 5L)))

  d <- d %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      ti %>% dplyr::select(state, date, target_id),
      by = c("state", "date")
    )

  pred_list <- split(d$pred, d$target_id)
  pred_list <- pred_list[as.character(ti$target_id)]

  stopifnot(length(pred_list) == 2300L, all(lengths(pred_list) == 500L))

  cat(sprintf(
    "[%s] 2300 targets built; fold 1 = 460 calibration, folds 2-5 = %d evaluation\n",
    label, sum(ti$fold != CALIBRATION_FOLD)
  ))

  list(target_info = ti, pred_list = pred_list)
}

eval_fold <- function(ti, pl, idx, theta, seed = CAL_SEED) {

  set.seed(seed)

  wis <- numeric(length(idx))
  hit50 <- logical(length(idx))
  hit80 <- logical(length(idx))
  hit95 <- logical(length(idx))

  for (k in seq_along(idx)) {

    i <- idx[k]

    s <- core_scores(
      draws_sorted = nb_draws_sorted(pl[[i]], ti$population[i], theta),
      observed_rate = ti$obs[i]
    )

    obs_i <- ti$obs[i]

    wis[k] <- s[["wis"]]
    hit50[k] <- obs_i >= s[["lower_50"]] && obs_i <= s[["upper_50"]]
    hit80[k] <- obs_i >= s[["lower_80"]] && obs_i <= s[["upper_80"]]
    hit95[k] <- obs_i >= s[["lower_95"]] && obs_i <= s[["upper_95"]]
  }

  list(
    mean_wis = mean(wis),
    coverage = c(cov50 = mean(hit50), cov80 = mean(hit80), cov95 = mean(hit95))
  )
}

calibrate_theta <- function(
    built,
    label,
    objective = c("coverage", "wis"),
    lo = THETA_GRID_LO,
    hi = THETA_GRID_HI,
    n_coarse = N_COARSE,
    n_fine = N_FINE
) {

  objective <- match.arg(objective)

  ti <- built$target_info
  pl <- built$pred_list

  idx <- which(ti$fold == CALIBRATION_FOLD)
  stopifnot(length(idx) == 460L)

  loss_of <- function(theta) {

    e <- eval_fold(ti = ti, pl = pl, idx = idx, theta = theta)

    list(
      loss = if (objective == "wis") e$mean_wis else sum((e$coverage - NOMINAL)^2),
      mean_wis = e$mean_wis,
      coverage = e$coverage
    )
  }

  grid1 <- exp(seq(log(lo), log(hi), length.out = n_coarse))
  res1  <- lapply(grid1, loss_of)
  loss1 <- vapply(res1, `[[`, numeric(1), "loss")
  best1 <- which.min(loss1)

  if (best1 %in% c(1L, length(grid1))) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "[%s | %s] coarse optimum is on grid boundary: theta = %.3f. Expand the grid and rerun.",
      label, objective, grid1[best1]
    ))
  }

  grid2 <- exp(seq(
    log(grid1[best1 - 1L]), log(grid1[best1 + 1L]), length.out = n_fine
  ))
  res2  <- lapply(grid2, loss_of)
  loss2 <- vapply(res2, `[[`, numeric(1), "loss")
  best2 <- which.min(loss2)

  if (best2 %in% c(1L, length(grid2))) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "[%s | %s] fine optimum is on refinement boundary: theta = %.3f",
      label, objective, grid2[best2]
    ))
  }

  best_result <- res2[[best2]]

  cat(sprintf(
    "[%s | %s] theta = %.3f | fold-1 coverage = %.3f / %.3f / %.3f\n",
    label, objective, grid2[best2],
    best_result$coverage["cov50"],
    best_result$coverage["cov80"],
    best_result$coverage["cov95"]
  ))

  list(
    theta = grid2[best2],
    objective = objective,
    cal_mean_wis = best_result$mean_wis,
    cal_coverage = best_result$coverage,
    grid = dplyr::bind_rows(
      tibble::tibble(theta = grid1, loss = loss1, stage = "coarse"),
      tibble::tibble(theta = grid2, loss = loss2, stage = "fine")
    )
  )
}

score_model <- function(built, theta, seed = SCORE_SEED) {

  ti <- built$target_info
  pl <- built$pred_list

  keep <- which(ti$fold != CALIBRATION_FOLD)
  stopifnot(length(keep) == 1840L, all(ti$fold[keep] %in% 2:5))

  set.seed(seed)

  score_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(keep), ncol = 12L)

  for (k in seq_along(keep)) {
    i <- keep[k]
    score_matrix[k, ] <- core_scores(
      draws_sorted = nb_draws_sorted(pl[[i]], ti$population[i], theta),
      observed_rate = ti$obs[i]
    )
  }

  colnames(score_matrix) <- c(
    "predictive_median",
    "wis", "wis_absolute_error", "wis_dispersion",
    "wis_underprediction", "wis_overprediction",
    "lower_50", "upper_50", "lower_80", "upper_80", "lower_95", "upper_95"
  )

  out <- dplyr::bind_cols(ti[keep, ], tibble::as_tibble(score_matrix)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      covered_50 = obs >= lower_50 & obs <= upper_50,
      width_50   = upper_50 - lower_50,
      covered_80 = obs >= lower_80 & obs <= upper_80,
      width_80   = upper_80 - lower_80,
      covered_95 = obs >= lower_95 & obs <= upper_95,
      width_95   = upper_95 - lower_95
    )

  decomposition_error <- max(abs(
    out$wis - (out$wis_absolute_error + out$wis_dispersion +
               out$wis_underprediction + out$wis_overprediction)
  ))

  stopifnot(
    nrow(out) == 1840L,
    dplyr::n_distinct(out$state) == 46L,
    identical(as.integer(table(out$fold)), rep(460L, 4L)),
    all(is.finite(out$wis)),
    all(out$width_50 >= 0), all(out$width_80 >= 0), all(out$width_95 >= 0),
  
    all(out$lower_95 <= out$lower_80),
    all(out$lower_80 <= out$lower_50),
    all(out$lower_50 <= out$upper_50),
    all(out$upper_50 <= out$upper_80),
    all(out$upper_80 <= out$upper_95),
    decomposition_error < 1e-10
  )

  out
}
```

```{r}
summarise_model <- function(rows, theta, label, objective) {
  rows %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      model = label,
      objective = objective,
      theta = theta,
      mean_wis = mean(wis),
      coverage_50 = mean(covered_50),
      coverage_80 = mean(covered_80),
      coverage_95 = mean(covered_95),
      mean_width_95 = mean(width_95)
    )
}

compare_states <- function(rows_with, rows_without) {

  state_with <- rows_with %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(wis_with = mean(wis), .groups = "drop")

  state_without <- rows_without %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(wis_without = mean(wis), .groups = "drop")

  dplyr::inner_join(state_with, state_without, by = "state") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(diff = wis_with - wis_without)
}

run_one <- function(built, label, objective) {

  calibration <- calibrate_theta(built = built, label = label, objective = objective)
  rows <- score_model(built = built, theta = calibration$theta)

  list(
    cal = calibration,
    rows = rows,
    summary = summarise_model(rows, calibration$theta, label, objective)
  )
}
```

```{r}
built_without <- build_targets(boot_full_without, "WITHOUT")

target_without <- built_without$target_info %>% dplyr::arrange(state, date)

stopifnot(
  identical(target_with$state, target_without$state),
  identical(target_with$date,  target_without$date),
  identical(target_with$fold,  target_without$fold),
  all(abs(target_with$obs - target_without$obs) < 1e-12)
)

res <- list(
  with_cov    = run_one(built_with,    "WITH",    PRIMARY_OBJECTIVE),
  without_cov = run_one(built_without, "WITHOUT", PRIMARY_OBJECTIVE),
  with_wis    = run_one(built_with,    "WITH",    SENSITIVITY_OBJECTIVE),
  without_wis = run_one(built_without, "WITHOUT", SENSITIVITY_OBJECTIVE)
)

saveRDS(res, "nb_calibration_scoring_all.rds")
```

```{r}
))

  "median state WIS: WITH = %.3f (IQR %.3f-%.3f) | WITHOUT = %.3f (IQR %.3f-%.3f)\n",

))

cat(sprintf(
  "states improved: %d / %d (median state WIS reduction %.1f%%)\n",
  sum(state_wis$diff < 0), nrow(state_wis),
  100 * (median(state_wis$wis_without) - median(state_wis$wis_with)) /
    median(state_wis$wis_without)
))

  "\nsensitivity (WIS-calibrated): theta = %.2f / %.2f | 95%% coverage = %.3f / %.3f | reduction = %.1f%%\n",
  res$with_wis$summary$theta, res$without_wis$summary$theta,
  res$with_wis$summary$coverage_95, res$without_wis$summary$coverage_95,
  100 * (res$without_wis$summary$mean_wis - res$with_wis$summary$mean_wis) /
    res$without_wis$summary$mean_wis
))
```
